benchmark_options.verified_facts: Official source:510 commercial contracts,13,000+ expert labels,41 clause types; dataset CC BY4.0.
benchmark_options.task_adaptation: Start with one document/window plus41 Noul questions using the official category definitions. Derive presence gold offline from nonempty annotated answer spans. Keep contract-level splits; all pages/windows from a contract remain in one split. Page-level evaluation requires reproducible page boundaries and span-to-page alignment, not arbitrary relabeling of document gold.
metrics: Micro and macro precision/recall/F1 over all41 labels
AUPRC where genuine comparable confidence is available
Invalid outputs and missing documents counted explicitly
benchmark_options.official_metric_boundary: The official CUAD evaluator matches predicted answer spans/text using Jaccard/substr rules and derives precision/recall curves. A41-label page/document-presence F1 is a different task and must never be labelled official CUAD extraction performance.
benchmark_options.next_step: Prepare a separate attributed evaluation-only derivative with source contract IDs, span/page mappings and deterministic policy. Use official holdout splits; thresholds/rubric choices fixed without test answers.

fairness_and_reporting_rules: Use identical frozen state/question/candidate content and ordered candidate keys, while recording unavoidable provider-specific outer prompt/schema formats. Gold and hidden environment state stay out of inference.

Do not use the test set to choose prompts, class descriptions, thresholds, candidate pruning or reasoning budgets. Keep all contract pages and related synthetic families within one split; report correlated rotations separately.

For a common decision-quality table, compare selected labels only. Choice selects the valid returned key, Noul uses a fixed threshold with an explicit tie rule, and categorical Score uses the selected/most probable level. Expected ordinal score and IR ranking are separate metrics.

No synthetic probability vectors for generative label-only models. Brier, ECE, NLL or soft-target calibration comparisons require genuine comparable probability output and a preregistered calibration policy.
Score actual integer/expected outputs without silent renormalization. Preserve Jev strict failures and any predeclared supplementary scalar analysis separately.
For CUAD, distinguish41-label presence F1 from official answer-span extraction evaluation. Never turn an upstream20-page anecdote into a full CUAD benchmark claim.

Report invalid/truncated/schema/transport responses as failures with the full planned denominator; unattempted cases remain pending. Preserve raw attempts, identities and all failures; no hidden retry, oracle repair, best-of selection or success-only evaluation.

Quality/latency operating points must state Qwen thinking flag and decoding; Luna none and Astra low are distinct settings. A later512/2048-token Qwen reasoning curve is separate from the fast non-thinking baseline.

Use same-GPU local comparisons for method efficiency: physical card, dtype, batch/concurrency, max context, attention implementation, transport, cache mode, load/warmup policy and exact package revision must be recorded. Measure complete validated answers, not only time to first token.

Existing2B H100 loopback versus Jev/OpenAI remote HTTPS latency is a deployment-path comparison with undisclosed remote hardware. Preserve the long-context32-candidate case where2B is slower. No energy, throughput or hardware-normalized speedup claim without new measurements.

Prefix caching remains off in the main Open-Jev path because probability parity failed9/11 workloads;440 selected decisions matching does not establish full probability parity. Any optimized path needs a separate parity-verified efficiency report.

For repeated latency, keep the existing measured20 plus3 warmup protocol per workload/path, concurrency1 and no retries when extending that table; log server-cache hits, tokens and full response wall time. Run-to-run comparisons must identify dates and possible provider drift.

IR methods share exact BM25 candidates and complete qrels; disclose pairwise versus adaptive listwise computation. A reranker score is not automatically a calibrated generic Noul or multi-level Score.

For games/browser, all models use identical environment versions,seeds,observations,legal actions and budgets. Measure continuous full episodes with real terminal success, and report candidate-generator limitations. Do not pass oracle-selected candidates or use scripted reference actions as model outputs.

Public demos may be reviewed successes with clear labels; scientific aggregates and logs must include failures. Do not summarize the small frozen suites, a pilot subset or an adapter-only preparation as all domains/cases completed.
